name: Indoor Swapmeet of Stanton
demographics: The Indoor Swapmeet of Stanton attracts a diverse, value-conscious demographic primarily consisting of working-class families and bargain hunters from Orange County's central communities. The trade area draws heavily from Hispanic and Asian households with moderate income levels, typically ranging from $40,000 to $70,000 annually, who appreciate the flea market atmosphere and negotiable pricing. Visitors span multiple generations, with a strong presence of families with children and older adults seeking affordable goods, household items, and ethnic products. The shopping pattern emphasizes weekend visits, with customers spending extended time browsing multiple vendor stalls for deals on everything from clothing and electronics to fresh produce and handmade crafts.
description: Indoor Swapmeet of Stanton has been a beloved Orange County shopping destination since its establishment, offering a unique indoor flea market experience at 10401 Beach Boulevard in Stanton, California. This vibrant marketplace brings together dozens of independent vendors under one roof, creating a bustling bazaar atmosphere where shoppers can discover everything from clothing and accessories to electronics, home goods, fresh produce, and specialty items. Unlike traditional shopping centers, the swapmeet format allows for direct interaction with vendors, often enabling price negotiation and creating a more personal shopping experience that has kept customers returning for decades. Operating daily from 10 AM to 7 PM, the facility provides a climate-controlled environment that makes browsing comfortable year-round, distinguishing it from outdoor flea markets. With a solid 3.9-star rating from nearly 1,000 Google reviews, the Indoor Swapmeet of Stanton has established itself as a community gathering place where diverse cultures converge, small businesses thrive, and treasure hunters can always find unexpected deals and unique merchandise not available in conventional retail stores.
summary: Indoor Swapmeet of Stanton is a bustling indoor flea market on Beach Boulevard featuring dozens of independent vendors selling everything from clothing and electronics to fresh produce and specialty goods. This climate-controlled marketplace offers a unique bargain-hunting experience with negotiable prices and a diverse selection that has made it a community favorite for decades.
